title: COP17 Green Zone · public science and innovation programme · October 23
titleRu: COP17 Green Zone · открытая научная и инновационная программа · 23 октября
venue: Karen Demirchyan Sports and Concerts Complex · COP17 Green Zone
coordinateNote: Complex footprint point, not a verified entrance.
source: Official COP17 Yerevan Green Zone agenda and public-attendee registration
priceNote: No admission price was found on the checked public registration page; do not imply free admission.
languageEvidence: Agenda specifies individual session languages, predominantly English and Armenian; not every session is bilingual.
description: Public science, sustainability and innovation programme. Registration required. This is the Green Zone, not accreditation to UN negotiating sessions. See the daily agenda.
descriptionRu: Открытая программа о науке, устойчивом развитии и инновациях. Нужна регистрация. Это Green Zone, а не аккредитация на переговорные заседания ООН. Расписание сессий по ссылке.
dateEvidence: Official homepage explicitly gives October 19–30, 2026; dated agenda contains public sessions starting 10:00 on this date. This time is the first programme session, not a verified door-opening time.
countingRule: One dated occurrence of the public programme. Individual sessions, films, exhibitions and concerts are not counted as separate conferences.

endTimeEvidence.meaning: End of the last scheduled scientific/public-policy session in the checked daily agenda, not the building closing time.
